rules.reason: a customer may always see their own balance and how it got there; they may not WRITE it -- the balance is a rollup, and the settings that drive auto top-up are changed through an owner-gated form, not by editing a number
owners tune their own auto top-up threshold, amount and cap; balance_minor is computed and refused by the write path regardless

every customer can see exactly why their balance is what it is -- the statement is the ledger, not a summary of it. No create/update/delete: entries are written server-side by the metering, top-up and refund paths, and a client that could append its own credit could print money
